nom: Paula's Choice Calm Nourishing Milky Toner

avis.titre: Fantastic toner for dry, sensitive, rosacea-prone skin!
avis.texte: I'm a big fan of Paula's Choice skincare and have been for years. This toner is one of the best products, IMO. The consistency is very light, with a milky texture. It provides light hydration for my rosacea-prone skin. It's gentle and soothing. I use it twice a day, morning and night, before applying the rest of my skincare products. No sensitivity or irritation. Highly recommend!

I'm a bit mad that I found this because I like it so much lol and it's not cheap! Seriously, after like a week of use, you will notice skin more hydrated. It's not a dramatic change, but for someone with dry combo skin, it's a miracle! Important for best result: Apply on almost wet face right after washing it so it soaks together with water

I have rosacea and very sensitive skin. I don’t have any reactions with this at all. Feels very calming on my skin. This toner makes my skin feel and look hydrated. I can tell the difference when I don’t use it as opposed to when I do. After applying moisturizer my skin has a slight soft glow. I apply the resist moisturizer when my face is still slightly damp from the toner and my pores drink the moisturizer. My skin looks amazing. I’ve gotten so many compliments when I use the toner. I feel they both work together to make my skin look beautiful.

I love me some good skincare products and I have slight Rosacea so I did some research and the Paula’s Choice Milky Toner was highly recommended so I decided to try it and I really like it. It’s gentle on my face and you only need to use a small amount on a cotton round to cover your face, neck and Décolleté. It’s inexpensive and a bottle lasts a long time. Love this facial toner!

I use this in a set with the calm toner, serum and moisturizer. This set of products has been a gamechanger to me and I don't even have rosacea or eczema. I have a tendency to pick at my skin which is worse when it feels irritated from recent exfoliation. I was able to attack the irritation fully with this routine and as a result I no longer absentmindedly pick at my skin and it has healed tremendously. It is great for my moisture barrier, though I find on dry summer days I need a second moisturizer to lock in the calming effect for the entire day.
This has helped my dark spots and given me a more even skin tone. It feels nice going on the face. I use it everyday.
She’s milky she soft and it’ll make your skin feel amazing. Definitely recommend for those that live in super dry climate cause she’ll get your hydrated.

avis.titre: Caused a bad breakout and did not hydrate
avis.texte: I have rosacea and have extremely dry skin. This product did not work at all for me. It caused a horrible breakout. It leaves a sticky film on your skin and does not hydrate whatsoever. The product rolled on my skin into little balls and gave me a rash on my cheeks and chin. I don’t recommend this for people with dry skin/rosacea. I had high hopes for this product because I use one of their other products and love it, however this toner was a total letdown.

This is heaven sent. I was struggling with intense dry under eyes and fine lines showing a lot lately. I saw this product on a YouTube video and decided to try it as she recommend gently applying it under the eye. Of course I did my own research ( chatgpt) lol to make sure each ingredient was safe for that area. I am literally shocked by the difference.
As someone with sensitive skin I found this Non- irritating, hydrating and soothing for the skin.
Very moisturizing and refreshing - but does not make my skin feel as clean AND moisturized as the "enriched calming toner" does
